blocks.text: What Information Do We Collect From Visitors to Our Websites?
blocks.html: What Information Do We Collect From Visitors to Our Websites?

blocks.text: Upon visiting our Websites, our server automatically logs your visit. The server logs may include information such as your web request, Internet Protocol (IP) address, browser type, browser language, the date and time of your request, and one or more cookies that may uniquely identify your browser.

The server logs may include information such as your web request, Internet Protocol (IP) address, browser type, browser language, the date and time of your request, and one or more cookies that may uniquely identify your browser.

blocks.text: Additionally, we collect the information you expressly provide. When using our Websites – for example, by subscribing to a newsletter, filling out a form, commenting on a blog post or article, or taking a certification quiz – you may be asked to enter your name, e-mail address, mailing address, phone number or other contact information. You may also be asked to provide information that will assist us in referring you or a loved one to an appropriate treatment centre, such as information relating to the condition or ailment you wish to treat and your insurance information. Similarly, we may collect payment information, such as credit and debit card numbers, when you make purchases through the Websites.

blocks.text: Do We Disclose Visitors’ and Users’ Information to Third Parties?
blocks.html: Do We Disclose Visitors’ and Users’ Information to Third Parties?

blocks.text: We do not sell or trade to outside parties the information we collect from you other than as set forth herein. We may disclose information collected from and about you to select trusted treatment partners in order to match you with an appropriate treatment centre. We may disclose the information we collect to third parties, including to our affiliates and business partners, who assist us in operating our Websites, conducting our business, or servicing you, so long as those parties agree to keep this information confidential. We may also release your information in order to comply with the law, to respond to legal process (such as a search warrant, subpoena or court order), to enforce the policies of our Websites, or to protect our or others’ rights, property, or safety. Non-personally identifiable visitor information (including unique device identifiers) may be provided to other parties for marketing, advertising, or other uses. We may also disclose your personal information with your express consent for other purposes not listed here. We may disclose your personal information to a potential or actual acquirer, successor, or assignee as part of any reorganization, merger, sale, joint venture, assignment, transfer or other disposition of all or any portion of our business, assets or stock (including in bankruptcy or similar proceedings).

blocks.text: Your Ontario Privacy Rights
blocks.html: Your Ontario Privacy Rights

blocks.text: Addiction Rehab Centres and its Websites are governed by the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).
